rule: A custom walker's battle ground speed (UnitViewConfig.moveSpeed, world units / s) is the mean installed moveSpeed of the vanilla Olden Era units named as its class references: units of a similar body plan, size and battle role. The Move clip is then stride matched to that speed (stride_match_glb.py); the speed is never lowered to fit a short DEF stride. targetMoveSpeed is pinned and must equal round(mean(refs), 3) over the installed vanilla view rows (tools/validate_unit_move_speed_normalization_contract.py).
consumers: tools/release_port/apply_release_core_overlay.py (normalize_custom_unit_view_move_speeds: writes moveSpeed into the unit's Core view row)
tools/homm3_def_retarget_delivery/stride_match_glb.py (view_move_speed: the ground speed the Move is stride matched to, and freeze_slice's stride gate)
adoption: Only `units` is consumed. `proposed` carries mappings awaiting review; a unit moves from `proposed` to `units` when its rebuilt Move has been reviewed at the new speed. Stronghold walkers adopted 2026-09-28 (user: "both approved" after the orc chieftain / wolf raider pilot). Fortress walkers (gnoll, lizardman, basilisk, gorgon, hydra lines) adopted 2026-09-28 under the user's standing goal approval; their Move clips are rebuilt stride-matched to the new speed and re-frozen before the Fortress slice ships.

small_humanoid_infantry.reason: Goblins: one-hex, tier-1 sized biped foot soldiers. Troglodyte (their Core donor), ghoul and esquire are the vanilla one-hex humanoid infantry of that size.

medium_humanoid_infantry.reason: Orcs: one-hex, human-sized biped infantry (thrower). The Core donor blade_dancer (5.8) is a sprinting elf dancer; the vanilla human-sized marching infantry are esquire, crossbowman and cultist.

large_humanoid_brute.reason: Ogres and cyclopes: one-hex, heavy bipeds a head or more taller than a man. Minotaur and ent are the vanilla heavy, large bipeds; both lumber at 2.7-2.83.

mounted_beast_rider.reason: Wolf riders: a rider on a running beast mount. The Core donor assassin (3.33) is a walking biped; the vanilla mounted units are sunlight cavalry (horse) and frostworm rider.

large_beast_quadruped.reason: Behemoths: a large running beast on four legs. The Core donor black_dragon (7.0) is a flier; the vanilla large ground beasts are unicorn, qilin and gorilla.

multi_headed_reptile.reason: Hydras: a massive two-hex many-headed reptile on short legs. The vanilla OE hydra (Dungeon) is the same creature and body plan; the only vanilla reference that fits.

small_flier.reason: Tiny winged bodies (sprites, dragonflies, the vermin swarm). Pixie, twinkle, flicker and wasp are the vanilla fliers of that size; they dart at 6-7.33.

medium_flier.reason: One-hex fliers from man to horse size (gargoyles, harpies, wights, vampires, griffins, pegasi, genies, efreet, flying elementals, stormbirds, small dragons). Griffin, kitten_horn and vampire are the vanilla one-hex fliers of that size.

large_flier.reason: Big two-hex fliers (dragons, angels, rocs, manticores, wyverns, couatls, firebirds, the ghost behemoth). Angel, phoenix, dragon and black dragon are the vanilla large fliers.

fliers: A flier (Core units_logics stats.moveType "fly", and a HoMM3 flier in reference/homm3_fliers.json where it has a DEF-retarget lab unit) is normalized only in a moveType "fly" class, a walker only in a "walk" class. stride_match_glb.py does not stride match a flier: its Move is flown with no planted contact, and OE plays every Move clip at 0.8 x battleSpeed whatever the moveSpeed (vanilla pixie 6 and angel 7 fly one clip rate), so there is no native wing-cadence coupling to match. A flier's speed is a speed decision only.

notNormalized.h3_crystal_dragon: Core moveType fly but HoMM3 walker (reference/homm3_fliers.json): the two sources disagree; settle the class first.
notNormalized.h3_devil, h3_devil_upg, h3_devil_upg_alt: HoMM3 flier/teleporter lab but Core moveType is not fly: the two sources disagree; settle the class first.

proposedHeld.h3_orc: no stride-matched DEF-retarget delivery for this game sid (h3_orc is not in the Stronghold slice); its shipped Move would not be matched to the new speed
